scope: Baseline and public reproduction dedicated daemon consumer cleanup
observations: Positive old-epoch daemon and entire worker-parent barrier precedes creator cancellation.
Damaged creator receipts prohibit restart, retain failures and leave the run fenced.
Publication errors remain failures and cannot produce cleanup completion.
A daemon-wide lock covers the entire execution and cleanup lifecycle.
The exact dedicated socket and worker slice are enforced, including all nested workers and baseline services.
operator_constraint: Provisioning, execution and reconciliation use the same exact registered operator kernel parent; a new transient parent cannot silently reuse the manifest.
